summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Filter Preset feature implementation. All backend APIs working perfectly, frontend UI components functioning correctly across all pages, and integration between MongoDB team presets and localStorage personal presets working excellently.

design_issues.issue: HTML validation warning about nested buttons in filter panel
